pins.title: Standard of Comparison from NS-051
pins.text: The example record shows that the alternative route changes only the manner of obtaining a decision: the stand-in must hold authority, the decision must be tied to the very transaction, and the total value must still be checked.

pins.title: Finding on NS-073
pins.text: On 19/07 the system outage was real, so the use of the fallback route had grounds; yet the records do not show a specific approval decision for a transaction of 1.8 million, nor that the total value was reassessed and escalated to the right level.

pins.title: Finding on NS-101
pins.text: On 14/10 the exception type “legal deadline” contradicts the supporting document, which shows only an internal programme milestone; and no evidence has been found of independent approval at the right level, nor of a reassessment of the NST-01 total at 2.6 million.

pins.title: Conclusion on Oversight
pins.text: The monitoring report allows the cluster of three Northstar/NST-01 exceptions to be perceived; Sophia then opened IC-25-104 to request clarification. Control monitoring is a function that commonly belongs to audit/internal control and works after a transaction has arisen, so it does not of itself prove that she knew of, or could have prevented, the earlier items before that time.
